label: AI Character Chat
note: verified 2026-09-02: a #{addCharacter:…} link opened the app's add-character dialog with name and description prefilled (Pantheon transcript, browser pane). The character travels in the URL hash, the form the app itself uses for its built-in characters. Lorebooks: uploaded as AICC plain-text lore (one paragraph per entry) and attached to a narrator character via loreBookUrls; a character with an embedded book gets the book attached the same way.

label: AI RPG
note: 2026-09-02: ai-rpg loads #data=uup1:<upload> / #data=<url> as a shared adventure (format perchance-ai-rpg-v1, read from its source)

label: AS-RPG
note: read from its source 2026-11-02: #data=uup1:<file> (or a URL), plain or .gz, parsed as perchance-ai-rpg-v1 and added as a new adventure, the same contract as ai-rpg.

label: AI Girlfriend Chat
note: verified 2026-09-05: same engine as ai-character-chat (its own addCharacter handler and loreBookUrls), and a #{addCharacter:…} link opened its add-character dialog prefilled, watched in a browser.

label: ASChat
note: verified 2026-09-05: ASChat runs the ai-character-chat engine (its own addCharacter handler, urlNamedCharacters and loreBookUrls). A #{addCharacter:…} link opened its editor with the name and the avatar already loaded, watched in a browser.

label: BlizzardUI
note: Read from its source 2026-09-09: its perchance-ai-rpg-v1 importer maps codexStructured.npcs[] to the cast, the protagonist fields to the protagonist, and codexTrackedInfo to a locked lore entry — so characters and lorebooks ride the same #data=uup1: door as scenarios, with no receiver code anywhere.

label: Aether
note: Same importer as BlizzardUI. label: FurAI
note: format read from a shipped generator that uses this flow in production (2026-09-05): ?char_import=<url to FurAI's own JSON>&name=<Name>. Watched FurAI download and read a probe card through it, but not the character landing in its list, so it stays hidden until that is seen.

label: Scenario PetrafiedACC
note: verified 2026-09-05: the same #{addCharacter:…} hash as ai-character-chat opened its Basic Info panel with the name prefilled, watched in a browser.

label: Sonder
note: verified 2026-10-21: ?pan=aicharactercards:character:100 on the live page reached the generator frame (Perchance forwards the query string) and Sonder opened Astarion from the library with add / add & chat, watched in a browser. Sonder reads ?pan at boot through pan.receive(); lorebooks and scenarios take the same road (a scenario becomes a narrator character), covered by Sonder's own flows, not yet watched live.

label: MNO RPG Engine
note: read from its source 2026-11-02: ?importdata=[<name>~]<32 hex>.gz, fetched only from user.uploads.dev and gunzipped; an mno-world file loads directly. The plugin builds the world, uploads it gzipped and checks the name it gets back; when the name is not <32 hex>.gz the world downloads and MNO opens on Import World.

label: Vellum
note: Vellum reads Pantheon through the plugin; its ?pan=<id> receive is the contract sent to the Vellum session 2026-11-02. Unverified, so hidden, until Vellum ships it and Open in Vellum is watched live.
